rung_purposes.purpose: Set parameters for fill threshold D122, leak limit D120, and overpressure limit D123.
Detect sensor PT-2001 wire break when pressure D100 is below -500.
Latch overpressure alarm M291 when pressure D100 exceeds limit D123.
Latch supply air low alarm M293 when air pressure X22 is lost during cycle.
Reset alarms M290, M291, and M293 via fault reset pushbutton X1.
Activate fault summary M299 and beacon Y25 on active alarm or E-stop open.
Energize vent valve Y22 via manual vent pushbutton X25 when not in Auto.
Start cycle (M200, M201) on pallet arrival X23 in Auto mode without faults.
Transition from Clamp step M201 to Fill step M202 when clamp closed X20 is made.
Run fill timer T21 (8.0s) during Fill step M202.
Latch fill timeout alarm M290 if timer T21 expires.
Transition from Fill step M202 to Stabilise step M203 when pressure reaches D122.
Run stabilise timer T22 (5.0s) during Stabilise step M203.
Latch initial test pressure D100 into D110 when test timer T23 triggers.
Transition from Stabilise step M203 to Test step M204 when timer T22 completes.
Run leak test timer T23 (10.0s) during Test step M204.
Store final pressure D111 and compute pressure decay D112 when timer T23 expires.
Evaluate decay D112 against limit D120 and set PASS (M210) or FAIL (M211).
Transition from Test step M204 to Vent step M205 when timer T23 completes.
Abort cycle to Vent step M205 and set FAIL result on fault summary M299.
Run vent timer T200 during Vent step M205.
Transition from Vent step M205 to Unclamp step M206 when vented below 100 and T200 done.
Transition from Unclamp step M206 to Complete step M207 when clamp open X21 is made.
Reset Complete step M207 and station busy M200 when pallet leaves test position X23.
Energize clamp close solenoid Y20 during clamping, filling, stabilise, test, and vent.
Energize fill valve Y21 during Fill step M202 when no fault summary is active.
Energize vent valve Y22 during Vent step M205 or on overpressure alarm M291.
Output PASS signal Y23 or FAIL signal Y24 to line controller during Complete step M207.
End of program scan.
